title: Vietnamese summer rolls with prawns
steps: Cook the prawns in simmering water for 2–3 minutes, cool them in cold water and halve them lengthways.
Pour boiling water over the rice noodles, leave for 4 minutes, drain and let cool.
Cut the cucumber and carrot into thin sticks, wash the lettuce and herbs.
Dip the rice paper sheets one at a time briefly in warm water, fill with lettuce, noodles, vegetables, herbs and prawns and roll up tightly.
For the dip, stir the peanut butter with lime juice, fish sauce, sugar and 2 tbsp warm water until smooth and serve with the rolls.
